text.p: Property developer and manager Mirvac Ltd said on Tuesday it would continue to expand its hotel division.
"The hotel division will continue to expand, maximising upward market pressures," Mirvac said in releasing its annual results for 1995/96.
"We are actively investigating opportunities to extend our brands, Quay West, Sebel, Marriott and Plaza, and look forward to the opening of Quay West Auckland during the 1996/97 year," it said.
"We are pursuing further management and development opportunities for our key brands in Australia and New Zealand to expand the Mirvac Hotel Group."

Earlier Mirvac announced a 21 percent increase in net profit for the year to June 30 to A$21.75 million and set a four cent per share final dividend, up from three cents in 1994/95, taking the total dividend to seven cents from five cents.
Mirvac's sales for the year rose to A$337.63 million from A$216.50 million.
The development division's contribution to the result was generated by revenues received from 1180 dwellings in 1995/96, up from 775 dwellings in 1994/95.
The Mirvac Hotel group had kept occupancy rates over 80 percent over the last three years and increased average room rates 11 percent to A$160 per night through 1995/96.

"This division currently has 1419 rooms under management in Australia, predominantly under the Quay West, Sebel and Marriott brands which generated revenue increases of 20 percent over last year," it said.
Mirvac said its property portfolio under the management of Mirvac Real Estate had increased to over A$820 million during the year.
Mirvac's share price was unchanged at A$1.89 at 12.50 p.m. (0050 GMT).
